senses.sense_definition: Iemand die een bedrijf voor eigen rekening start of runt.

examples.text: Mijn broer is een succesvolle <w>ondernemer</w> met drie winkels in de stad.

target_lang_translations.en: My brother is a successful <w>entrepreneur</w> with three shops in the city.
target_lang_translations.ru: Мой брат — успешный <w>предприниматель</w> с тремя магазинами в городе.
target_lang_translations.it: Mio fratello è un <w>imprenditore</w> di successo con tre negozi in città.

examples.text: Als zelfstandig <w>ondernemer</w> moet je vaak lange dagen werken.

target_lang_translations.en: As an independent <w>entrepreneur</w>, you often have to work long hours.
target_lang_translations.ru: Как частный <w>предприниматель</w>, тебе часто приходится работать допоздна.
target_lang_translations.it: Come <w>imprenditore</w> autonomo devi spesso lavorare molte ore.

target_lang_definitions.en: Someone who starts or runs a business for their own account.
target_lang_definitions.ru: Человек, который открывает или ведет бизнес за свой счет.
target_lang_definitions.it: Persona che avvia o gestisce un'attività commerciale per proprio conto.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: person who sets up a business taking on financial risks
general term for someone who owns a company

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: persona che esercita professionalmente un'attività economica organizzata
persona che svolge un'attività lavorativa in proprio
